title: The fixed rule on net1 v5, validation links: the u grid over three campaign seeds
description: net1 v5 is net1 retrained with net1 v4's settings on the data regenerated under the frozen settings (exp-net1v4-recheck-79, at least as good as v4 on the same rows). Its fixed rule's u is chosen again: u in -0.25, 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5 for the rule on net1 v5, with BBRv3, on the 21 validation links and five families, for campaign seeds 11, 21 and 31 (each seed's report in s11/, s21/, s31/). The winner is the u with the highest mean over the five families on every seed, or, where seeds disagree or the gap is inside the noise, the one ahead on the mean over seeds; the share rule's k is chosen after, on this u. Validation links only; the test links run once, at the end.
prepare: N="$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"; U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v5" "$N" --u $U; P=(); for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "v5-u$u=$OUT/v5/rule-u$u.onnx"); done; for s in 11 21 31; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for s in 11 21 31; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --select v5; done; { for s in 11 21 31; do echo "# Campaign seed $s"; cat "$OUT/s$s/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
